title: Episodic Record
description: CoALA episodic memory: what happened. One record per step of one decision cycle. Ordered by the (session_id, cycle_id, step_no) triple, a run's full trajectory can be replayed exactly — which is what lets a crashed or retried loop recover rather than start cold.

session_id.description: Groups every cycle belonging to one run of a host orchestration. Supplied by the host; the memory agent never invents it.

cycle_id.description: One CoALA decision cycle. Assigned by memory_open_cycle, or synthesised per-write when a host uses memory_remember without cycles.

parent_cycle_id.description: Set when a subagent's cycle nests inside a parent orchestration's cycle. Lets a fan-out tree be reconstructed.

step_no.description: Monotonic step index within the cycle, starting at 0. Two records in one cycle never share a step_no.

goal.description: What the agent was trying to achieve at this step. Copied down from the cycle so a single record is interpretable on its own.

action.description: The action taken. In CoALA terms this may be internal (reasoning, retrieval, learning) or external (grounding) — the memory agent records both but only ever performs internal ones itself.

class.description: CoALA action taxonomy. Grounding subtypes are recorded for hosts that perform them; the memory agent itself emits only internal actions.

name.description: Concrete action or tool name, e.g. 'web_search' or 'memory_recall'.

input.description: Arguments the action was called with. Redacted in place when memory_forget runs in redact mode.

observation.description: What came back. Written BEFORE the host proceeds, so a crash mid-cycle leaves evidence rather than a hole.

outcome.description: Result of the step. 'abandoned' is set by the daemon when it reaps a cycle that was opened and never closed.

reward.description: Optional scalar signal, -1 (harmful) to 1 (ideal). Reflection weights high-reward episodes more heavily when distilling semantic facts and procedural candidates.

error.description: Structured failure detail when outcome is 'failure'. Repeated identical errors across cycles are the strongest signal a procedural fix is needed.

tokens.description: Token accounting for the step, when the host tracks it. Enables cost analysis over a trajectory.
